name: Miyuki Kohana
source:
"Don't forget what happened today. She always learns from her mistakes."

Mashiro's grandmother. After losing her son and his wife, she raised Mashiro on her own. She is a calm and elegant woman, but her core strength and skill in navigating the world are certifiable. Even though she's older, she's still beautiful and gets asked out to dates all over the place.

She loves Mashiro from the bottom of her heart.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_kohana.png]official website[/url]]
